jobs.title: Commercial Operations Intern
jobs.location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates / Dubai, United Arab Emirates
jobs.text:
About us

Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.

About the Role:

Tamara is a leading buy now, pay later fintech operating across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, built around the mission of helping people Own Your Dream. A large part of how customers discover and use Tamara happens in-store—at the till and through conversations with store employees.

As a Merchant Field & Marketing Intern, you will be Tamara's on-ground representative across assigned partner stores. You will help ensure Tamara is visible, understood, and confidently recommended by store teams. This is a field role, not a desk role: you will spend most days visiting stores, building relationships, improving execution, gathering frontline insights, and reporting progress.

Duration and Performance Reviews

The internship is designed as a 90-day / 3-month programme. Performance will be reviewed weekly so interns receive timely feedback, clear priorities, and practical support to improve throughout the programme.

A formal progress assessment will take place at the end of the first 45 days. We want every intern to succeed and will provide regular guidance along the way. At the same time, consistent performance, reliability, quality of execution, and follow-through are essential to this field role. If performance at the 45-day assessment is not satisfactory, Tamara may conclude the internship at that stage rather than continue it through the full 90 days.

Your Responsibilities:

• Visit assigned merchant stores according to a planned route and schedule

• Check that Tamara signage, standees, counter cards, and other in-store materials are visible, accurate, current, and in good condition

• Fix simple execution gaps and escalate missing materials, operational blockers, or recurring issues

• Brief and retrain store managers, accountants, cashiers, and sales associates on how Tamara works and how to explain it clearly to customers

• Build strong working relationships with store teams so Tamara remains visible and confidently recommended between visits

• Maintain an accurate directory of key store contacts, including managers, finance contacts, checkout leads, and sales-floor leads

• Gather anonymised frontline insight from store employees about customer questions, objections, checkout drop-off, competitor mentions, and opportunities to improve conversion

• Capture approved photos and short videos for Tamara's marketing and UGC-style content

• Log every visit, including tasks completed, employees met, staff trained, issues found, insights gathered, evidence captured, and follow-up actions

• Submit a weekly report summarising store coverage, improvements, risks, recurring insights, and priorities for the following week

• Score stores against Tamara's evaluation framework and track progress from the current state to the target state

How Success Will Be Measured

• Completion of planned store visits

• Quality and consistency of in-store Tamara visibility

• Number of store employees trained and improvement in their Tamara knowledge

• Speed and quality of issue identification, escalation, and resolution

• Completeness of the store contact directory

• Quality of daily visit logs and weekly reports

• Usefulness of consumer and employee insights gathered

• Quantity and quality of approved content captured

• Improvement in store evaluation scores over time

Working Expectations

• Represent Tamara professionally and respect merchant operating hours

• Secure approval before capturing any in-store con

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.text:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

• Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

• Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

• Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

• Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

• Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

• Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

• Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

• 2+ years of professional software engineering

• Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

• Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

• Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

• Regular use of an AI coding tool

• Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

• You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

• At least 10 hours a week, starting now

• A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

• Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

• Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

• US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

• Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

• The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

• Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.location: Hybrid / Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
jobs.text:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Dubai, UAE

About the Team:

In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. You will do this through a maniacal focus on people, process, and tools. The Business Development organization is anchored in a culture focused on the development & training of its employees, incubating talent across the company, teamwork, and celebrating success. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.

This is a great opportunity to be a member of our high performing Sales team at a hyper-growth technology company. The Business Development Representative (BDR) will:

• Be the first point of contact for customers that need help finding solutions

• Develop your customer centric sales skills to deliver a stellar customer experience

• Learn Cloudflare’s products and services in detail

Similar to other roles that Cloudflare, this role has a tenure requirement of 18-24 months before you may be eligible to apply for another role within the company.

About the Role

Languages required: English

This is a great opportunity to be an early member of a high performing sales team at a fast growing technology company. We are looking for ownership-oriented team members with excellent communication skills and technical curiosity. As the Business Development Representative (BDR), you will:

• Create excellent customer experiences

• Learn customer-centric sales skills

• Become an expert in Cloudflare’s product

• Team members have opportunities to move into roles across the organization, especially in mid-market sales, customer success, solutions engineering, and sales operations

Day in the Life of BDR at Cloudflare

• Own and meet target quota related to number of qualified opportunities, response SLA, value of sales pipeline, and revenue

• Develop new business opportunities from inbound and marketing-generated leads

• Discover pain points and use case, map them to broad set of Cloudflare solutions and qualify for Enterprise sales opportunities

• Work cross-functionally with stakeholders (account executives, marketing, sales operations, fellow BDRs)

• Report, track, and manage sales activities and results using SFDC

• Play an active role in the creation and iteration of team processes

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

• Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

• Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

jobs.title: Tamara Builders Program
jobs.location: Riyadh Saudi Arabia,   Dubai United Arab Emirates  / Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
jobs.text:
Cohorts: June (yearly) | Function: Multiple, apply once and tell us where you want to build

About us

Tamara is Saudi Arabia's first FinTech unicorn, on a mission to help people own their dreams by building the most customer-centric financial super app in the world. There's no playbook for that; our Tamarians are writing it as we go, and we believe potential should be stretched early.

The Flagship Builders Program is our gateway for brilliant minds ready to kick-start their careers. Whether you're a recent graduate or early in your career with up to two years of experience, this is where you'll do real meaningful work, alongside some of the most ambitious people in the region.

This year, we’re keeping things simple: one application gets you into the running for any area you’re interested in. Just share a bit about yourself, highlight what you’re great at, and tell us which teams get you excited. We want you to work on what you’re passionate about, so we’ll look at your interests to match you with a role where you can jump in and start building.

Where You Could Build

Product: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn builds products people actually love. You'll support Product Managers in shaping features used by millions of shoppers, drawing on data and customer insight to explore areas for improvement, conceptualise new products, and dive into a wide range of financial services, from personal banking to brand new fintech solutions.

Engineering: Write code that ships. As part of our engineering team, you'll work alongside senior engineers on live projects, from feature builds to system improvements, gaining mentorship and real production experience from day one.

Design: Help design the experiences behind a product millions of people trust with their money. You'll contribute to real flows and interfaces, working closely with Product and Engineering to build seamless fintech solutions. You will dive directly into uncovering user needs, mapping out core user journeys, and rapidly iterating through wireframes.

Data: Get hands-on with the numbers behind millions of transactions. You'll support analytics and reporting that help teams understand customers, measure impact, and make better decisions.

Commercial: Our Commercial teams cover two sides of the same goal: Sales, where you'll help find, pitch, and sign new merchant partners, and Account Management, where you'll help look after existing partners and grow those relationships over time.

Marketing: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn tells its story. You'll support brand, growth, and campaign work that reaches customers and merchants across the region.

Finance & Accounting: Get inside the financial engine of a unicorn. You'll support month-end close, financial reporting, and audits, learning what it takes to keep a fast-scaling company's numbers accurate and controlled.

Strategy: Work close to the top. You'll contribute to market research, competitor benchmarking, and strategic projects that inform decisions made by Tamara's executive team: real exposure to strategic thinking at the highest level.

Note: The functions listed above aren't an exhaustive list. If you're interested in an area we haven't mentioned here, tell us on your application; we still want to hear from you.

What We Look For in a Builder

Experience

• A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is desirable, but we value proven experience and capability just as highly

• Up to 2 years of experience, including prior internships or co-ops

• Passionate about continuous iteration and bringing a creative mindset to solving problems, no matter the function.

• Some exposure to your area of interest, through coursework, internships, or projects, is a plus, but potential matters more than a perfect CV

Skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a bias toward data-driven decisions

• Excellent communication skills, written and verbal

• Organisational skills: able to prioritise, multi-tas

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.text:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

• Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands

• Skincare and beauty

• Tech and software

• Finance and investing

• Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability

• Education

• Home improvement

• Automobiles and motorcycles

• Health and wellness

• Medical and clinical fields

• Digital marketing

• SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities

• Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites

• Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy

• Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors

• Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices

• Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing

• Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications

• Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills

• 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred

• Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices

• Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics

• Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content

• Portfolio featuring published work preferred

• Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Binance Accelerator Programm - Software Engineer (Full-stack / AI-oriented)
jobs.location: Asia / Asia / Taiwan, Taipei / Hong Kong
jobs.text:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.
 
About Binance Accelerator Program
Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
 
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws
 

Responsibilities
• Participate in the full-stack development and maintenance of the KYC (Know Your Customer) system, covering both backend services and frontend features

• Assist in drafting and implementing the interface documentation for KYC business modules

• Participate in feature testing and regression for KYC releases, and help troubleshoot issues reported by the QA team

• Support the CS team in resolving and classifying customer issues for system improvement
Requirements
• Computer-related major, bachelor's degree (final-year students and fresh graduates are both welcome)

• Solid Java fundamentals and good understanding of OOP; basic awareness of multithreading and networking concepts

• Some exposure to Spring / Spring Boot (coursework or personal projects are sufficient)

• Familiar with basic MySQL usage; knowledge of NoSQL databases is a plus

• Basic understanding of common middleware such as Redis, RabbitMQ or Kafka (hands-on experience is a plus, not required)

• Full-stack interest: some frontend foundation (HTML/CSS/JavaScript); familiarity with React or Vue is preferred

• Good logical thinking, teamwork and a strong willingness to learn

• Able to read and write technical documents in English; good spoken English is an advantage
